name: read
body:
Range("H1").ClearContents
Range("J1").Value = "a"
Range("J2").Value = "b"
Range("J3").Value = "c"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(2, 0, 0, 90, 60)
sh.ControlFormat.AddItem "a"
sh.ControlFormat.AddItem "b"
sh.ControlFormat.AddItem "c"
sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
sh.ControlFormat.Value = 2
On Error Resume Next

n = Err.Number
Err.Clear
v = sh.ControlFormat.List
a = TypeName(v)
a = a & ":" & CStr(LBound(v)) & ":" & CStr(UBound(v))
e = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n) & "|" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & "|" & _
sh.ControlFormat.ListFillRange & "|" & CStr(Range("H1").Value) & "|" & a & ":" & CStr(e) & "|"
For i = 1 To sh.ControlFormat.ListCount
Report = Report & sh.ControlFormat.List(i) & ";"
Next i
Report = Report & "|" & CStr(Range("J1").Value) & ";" & CStr(Range("J2").Value) & ";" & CStr(Range("J3").Value)

name: replace
body:
Range("H1").ClearContents
Range("J1").Value = "a"
Range("J2").Value = "b"
Range("J3").Value = "c"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(6, 0, 0, 90, 60)
sh.ControlFormat.ListFillRange = "$J$1:$J$3"
sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
sh.ControlFormat.Value = 2
On Error Resume Next
sh.ControlFormat.List = Array("x", "y")
n = Err.Number
Err.Clear
v = sh.ControlFormat.List
a = TypeName(v)
a = a & ":" & CStr(LBound(v)) & ":" & CStr(UBound(v))
e = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n) & "|" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & "|" & _
sh.ControlFormat.ListFillRange & "|" & CStr(Range("H1").Value) & "|" & a & ":" & CStr(e) & "|"
For i = 1 To sh.ControlFormat.ListCount
Report = Report & sh.ControlFormat.List(i) & ";"
Next i
Report = Report & "|" & CStr(Range("J1").Value) & ";" & CStr(Range("J2").Value) & ";" & CStr(Range("J3").Value)
